{{Top|leg}}
'''Reis''' was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Kodaian]] of [[Kodai]] who had some knowledge of a [[Holocron of King Adas|Sith holocron]] that was hidden in Kodai's [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] provided information related to the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|90|Reis}}</ref>
